def greens(frame):
    out=[]
    for n in frame.segmentation['nodes']:

            rows=[p[0] for p in n['boundary']]; cols=[p[1] for p in n['boundary']]
            out.append(( (min(rows)+max(rows))//2, (min(cols)+max(cols))//2 ))
    return out

g = greens(current_frame)

clicks=[{'action':'MOUSE','row':r,'col':c} for (r,c) in g]
res = action(clicks)

print("level", current_frame.level, "step", current_frame.step)
</parameter>
</function>
